body:
# The Rocket Sword

A single powerful weapon that lets you dash through the air, fire explosive rockets, and blow things up.

---

## How to use

| Input | Action |
|---|---|
| **Tap** (right-click, release quickly) | Dash forward in your look direction |
| **Hold** (right-click, charge up) | Fire an explosive rocket with recoil |
| **Left-click** (melee) | Small launch boost forward |

- 5 second cooldown after each use
- Durability drains on use — dash costs 2, rocket costs 5
- The sword visually breaks during cooldown and returns when ready

---

## Crafting Recipe

![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92a8ee3c2c507dfc268c459311f12a4e9d8a00f1.png)

Requires mid-to-late game materials. You'll need to raid a Nether fortress first.

---

## Enchantments

Supports all standard sword enchantments (Sharpness, Mending, Unbreaking...) plus 5 custom ones:

![All five custom enchantments displayed on item frames: Afterburner, Overdrive, Heatseeker, Warhead and Zero-G](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2e0167298c72b32803148de74b406aabd61327a.png)

| Enchantment | Max Level | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| **Afterburner** | III | Reduces cooldown by 0.5s per level |
| **Overdrive** | III | +50% dash and rocket power per level |
| **Warhead** | III | +0.5 explosion radius and more damage per level |
| **Heatseeker** | III | Rocket locks onto and curves toward the nearest enemy |
| **Zero-G** | I | Negates fall damage after a dash or rocket launch |

> Without Zero-G you **will** take fall damage from your own rockets.

---

## Commands

```
/enchant @s rocketswordmod:afterburner 3
/enchant @s rocketswordmod:overdrive 3
/enchant @s rocketswordmod:warhead 3
/enchant @s rocketswordmod:heatseeker 3
/enchant @s rocketswordmod:zero_g 1
```

---

## Language Support

English, Spanish (Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Spain, Mexico, Uruguay, Venezuela)

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.227+
